Home.title: IsaPhilo Enterprise
Home.description: IsaPhilo Enterprise is the preferred partner for builders, specialising in building design, construction, maintenance, and the supply of essential building materials, including cement, iron rods, blocks, paints, plywood, and roofing sheets. We cater to domestic, commercial, and industrial building projects and are proud to be ranked No. 1 in building construction and as a supplier of building materials in the Western, Ashanti, and Central Regions of Ghana.
